observation.subject: GET /admin/catalog/products/{code}
observation.sentence: `GET /admin/catalog/products/{code}`: warm median 11 ms over 79 requests; Handler, other work 45 %, Response write 34 %, SQL 16 %. First request 22 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in the handler outside recorded calls: run Profile resources to see the route's hottest frames.
limitations: Some requests ran on virtual threads, whose CPU time and allocation the JVM does not report per thread: Profile resources samples them with JFR.
observation.unlistedReason: Its warm median is under 20 ms, and authorization takes under 20 % of its time and under 50 decisions a request, so it is not prominent.
